items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: When you had the band, you did "Concerto for Jazz Band and Orchestra" which Rolf Liebereson did

ctx.x: When you had the band, you did "Concerto for Jazz Band and Orchestra" which Rolf Liebereson did and it reached your band and the Chicago Symphony with Rich Reiner, what did you think of that as a piece of music and how did you get involved in it?
We got involved because RCA thought it would be a good thing for us to do. They asked us to.
